name: two_fraudulent_charges_two_disputes_one_each
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: Two taxi charges at 1:40am and 2:05am in another city are fraudulent; the deli charge at noon is the customer's. Exactly one dispute for each taxi charge and none for the deli.
tests: passes when the agent verifies and files exactly one dispute for TX327 and one for TX328, and none for TX329.
instruction:
You were asleep at home in Boston when two Nightline Taxi charges in New York ($32.00 at 1:40am and $41.00 at 2:05am on October 23) hit your credit card ending 9903. The $12.50 Corner Deli charge at noon that day is yours. You want both taxi charges disputed as unrecognised, and you do not want the card locked (you have already replaced it). Provide passcode 1184 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Ravi Krishnan
- Customer ID: C327
- Session ID: SESS327
- Card: CARD327 (ending 9903)
- Fraudulent: TX327 ($32.00), TX328 ($41.00)
- Legitimate: TX329 (Corner Deli)
- Passcode: 1184
